colorRules: Keep graphic backgrounds mainly white or warm white (#FAFAF7).
Use muted plum (#795C76) for primary concept or key phrase; terracotta (#C47C70) for human/emotional context.
Dusty rose (#E9DED8) should be a quiet field, not a full-screen saturated wash.
Preserve natural skin tones in footage; avoid clinical coldness or glowing brain graphics.
